$description: Contextual Workspace capability navigation. Direct chrome is bounded and reserved for the opened capability plus capability presence justified by current context. Available capabilities are progressively disclosed through More/menu; unavailable capabilities render no dead slot. Capability registration never implies permanent navigation. Web and App may present the same semantics differently; overflow remains menu-based rather than a feature-lobby sidebar. The App band is a compact pill floating over the terminal, so it declares its own touch floor instead of the 44px chrome default: chrome yields before the work surface, and the entries are secondary controls the user reaches deliberately rather than in a hurry (#730).
